editorial.blurb: Perilla Korean Steakhouse delivers expertly grilled meats and vibrant banchan in a setting that's equal parts date-night romance and celebration-ready warmth.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for happy hour to experience their well-crafted cocktails and shareable bites like dumplings, oysters, and pork skewers at better value—or book the Premium Steakhouse set experience if you're marking a special occasion and want the full ceremonial treatment.
signatureDishes: Korean Lunch tray with prime skirt steak
